items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: His son plays trumpet around here now.

ctx.x: Oh, yes. You've heard of him? We got a picture of him.
You got a picture of him? From... His son plays trumpet around here now.

Yes, I understand. His son, yeah. I think Arnold De Pass' widow is still living. Yeah, she is. Richard Beaulieu, I can't pronounce those French names, anyway, a drummer, Big Rudolph they call him. Yeah, yeah, that's a brother of him, yeah. Rudolph De Pass. Yeah. He had a picture of him. Yeah, Rudolph De Pass.
